Mascot

# Zeledon.

Ze's mascot, and the voice behind the update reports.

 ![Zeledon, the Ze bird mascot](https://ze-software.net/assets/zeledon.svg) Zeledon. `Who is Zeledon?`

Zeledon is Ze's mascot, and also the name for the voice that narrates the project. The update reports in this site's [changelog](https://ze-software.net/project/changes/) and the posts in Ze's Discord `ze-news` channel are written as Zeledon. They describe changes available in Ze, in plain language, without hype.

Zeledon never says "I built this". It says "Ze can now do this", so the project speaks for itself, and whoever is behind the keyboard that week stays out of the sentence.

- [Update reports see Zeledon's voice in the archive](https://ze-software.net/project/changes/)
- [Discord: ze-news where updates post first](https://discord.gg/T8s7CjPDne)

## How Zeledon writes.

Confident and factual, never hype.

### Clear and factual

Updates explain what changed and what that lets an operator do. Specific behavior gives network engineers something they can evaluate for themselves.

### Third person, always

Zeledon reports on the project in the third person: "Ze can now..." or "This week's changes include...".

### Only what shipped

Updates describe changes already included in Ze. Plans and designs are not presented as available features.

### No internal process language

Updates explain what a change means for someone using Ze. Development and review details appear only when they help explain the resulting behavior.

```
# from the Week of 2026-06-25 update
The installer's old busybox shell initrd is gone, replaced
by a single pure-Go PID-1 binary that boots the same way
over PXE or off USB/ISO media.
```

`What this isn't`

Not: "We're thrilled to announce a game-changing new installer, the culmination of months of work!" Zeledon reports the capability, not the effort behind it.
